name: gitsight
description: Enterprise-grade Git visualization for VS Code. Commit Graph, inline blame, file/line history, worktrees, branch & tag explorer, remotes, stashes, search & compare, AI commit messages. A free, open alternative to GitLens.

gitsight.graph.theme.description: Color palette for the commit graph lanes/branches.

gitsight.sparkline.days.description: Number of days to summarize in the commit sparkline status-bar item.

gitsight.sparkline.author.description: Whose commits to count in the sparkline: 'all' contributors or just 'me' (config user.email).

gitsight.blame.enabled.description: Show inline blame on the current line.

gitsight.heatmap.enabled.description: Color the gutter by commit age (heatmap).

gitsight.heatmap.coldDays.description: Days at which a line is considered cold.

gitsight.authors.enabled.description: Show per-line author colour stripe in the gutter.

gitsight.statusBar.enabled.description: Show repo summary in the status bar.

gitsight.graph.maxCommits.description: Maximum commits to render in the Commit Graph.

gitsight.graph.showAllBranches.description: Show commits from all branches in the Commit Graph.

gitsight.ai.provider.description: AI provider for GitSight. Only GitHub Copilot is supported (enterprise-safe, no local models, no third-party API keys). Users select a Copilot model via 'GitSight: Pick AI Model'.

gitsight.ai.preferredFamily.description: Optional Copilot model family preference (e.g. 'gpt-4o', 'claude-3-5-sonnet'). Leave empty to use last-picked model or auto-select.

gitsight.worktreePill.enabled.description: Show the current worktree name in the status bar (hidden when only one worktree exists). Click to open the worktree switcher.

gitsight.sync.pullMode.description: Strategy used by GitSight: Sync when pulling. 'rebase' uses --rebase --autostash so unpushed local commits stay on top.

gitsight.sync.pill.enabled.description: Show the Sync status-bar pill with ahead/behind counts. Click to run GitSight: Sync.

gitsight.workingTree.enabled.description: Show a status-bar pill summarizing the working tree (staged / modified / untracked / conflicted counts). Click to open the Source Control view.

gitsight.workingTree.hideWhenClean.description: Hide the Working-Tree pill when there is nothing staged, modified, untracked, or conflicted.

gitsight.recentFiles.commits.description: How many recent commits the Recent Files view scans to build its list.

gitsight.recentFiles.max.description: Maximum number of files to show in the Recent Files view.

gitsight.blameHover.enabled.description: Show a rich GitSight hover with commit subject, body, co-authors, and quick-action links.

gitsight.blameHover.showBody.description: Include the commit body in the blame hover.

gitsight.blameHover.showCoAuthors.description: Surface Co-authored-by trailers in the blame hover.

gitsight.blameHover.authorTint.description: Tint the author name in the blame hover by commit age (yellow / orange / red as the commit gets older), so you can glance and tell whether you're looking at fresh code or a 6-year fossil.

gitsight.blameHover.authorTintFresh.description: Also tint authors of recent commits (green). Off by default to keep the hover from looking like a Christmas tree on healthy code.

gitsight.blameHover.authorTintAgingDays.description: Days before an author name is tinted 'aging' (yellow) in the blame hover.

gitsight.blameHover.authorTintStaleDays.description: Days before an author name is tinted 'stale' (orange) in the blame hover.

gitsight.blameHover.authorTintAncientDay.description: Days before an author name is tinted 'ancient' (red) in the blame hover.

gitsight.gitignoreInsight.enabled.description: Show a CodeLens at the top of every .gitignore reporting how many files it is currently ignoring.

gitsight.gitignoreInsight.maxFiles.description: Cap on the number of ignored files scanned to attribute back to a .gitignore. Very large workspaces with huge node_modules trees should keep this conservative.

gitsight.fileCommitLens.enabled.description: Show a CodeLens at the top of every tracked file with its commit count, age span, and contributor count.

gitsight.fileCommitLens.maxCommits.description: Maximum commits to inspect per file when computing the per-file CodeLens. Larger values give better contributor counts on long-lived files but cost more git CPU.

gitsight.commitLint.enabled.description: Lint commit messages — surfaces problems as diagnostics in COMMIT_EDITMSG and as a status-bar pill summary of the SCM input box.

gitsight.commitLint.showPill.description: Show the commit-linter status-bar pill summarising the current SCM input message.

gitsight.commitLint.maxSubjectLength.description: Maximum allowed length of the commit subject line (the first line).

gitsight.commitLint.maxBodyLength.description: Recommended wrap width for commit body lines. Lines longer than this raise a warning.

gitsight.commitLint.requireBlankLineAfte.description: Warn when the second line of the message is non-empty (Conventional Commits requires a blank line between subject and body).

gitsight.commitLint.warnTrailingWhitespa.description: Warn on lines with trailing whitespace.

gitsight.commitLint.warnLowercaseSubject.description: Warn when the subject starts with a lowercase letter (excluding Conventional Commits prefixes like 'feat:').

gitsight.commitLint.warnSubjectPeriod.description: Warn when the subject ends with sentence-ending punctuation ('.', '!', '?').

gitsight.commitLint.warnWipPrefix.description: Block commits whose subject starts with WIP, fixup!, squash!, or amend!.

gitsight.commitLint.warnMissingBody.description: Warn when the subject ends with ':' but no body is provided.

gitsight.branchAge.agingDays.description: Days at which a branch starts to be tagged 'aging' (yellow) in the Branches tree.

gitsight.branchAge.staleDays.description: Days at which a branch is tagged 'stale' (orange) in the Branches tree.

gitsight.branchAge.ancientDays.description: Days at which a branch is tagged 'ancient' (red) in the Branches tree. Use Branch Cleanup to delete merged ones in bulk.

gitsight.rebaseCoach.enabled.description: Show the Rebase Coach status-bar pill when a rebase is in progress, and offer a quick-pick of next actions (continue/skip/abort/open conflict).

gitsight.coAuthors.scanCommits.description: How many recent commits to scan when finding co-author suggestions.

gitsight.coAuthors.selfEmails.description: Extra email addresses (lowercase) the user considers their own; excluded from co-author suggestions in addition to git's user.email.

gitsight.conflictMarker.enabled.description: Surface unresolved Git conflict markers (<<<<<<<, =======, >>>>>>>) as Error diagnostics in open files.

gitsight.conflictMarker.showPill.description: Show a status-bar pill with the conflict count when the active editor has unresolved markers.

gitsight.recentBranches.reflogWindow.description: How many reflog entries to scan when building the Recent Branches list. Larger windows catch older switches at the cost of a slightly slower picker.

gitsight.recentBranches.showLimit.description: Maximum number of recent branches to show in the picker.

gitsight.lastTagPill.enabled.description: Show a status-bar pill with the most recent tag and the number of commits since it. Click for tag actions (copy, open on remote, show shortlog, checkout).

gitsight.lastTagPill.preferStable.description: When enabled, prefer the newest stable semver tag over a pre-release (rc/beta/alpha) when both are present, so the pill shows the version users actually have.

gitsight.lockfileWatch.enabled.description: Show a one-click notification when a known lockfile (package-lock.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, yarn.lock, Cargo.lock, go.sum, Gemfile.lock, poetry.lock, composer.lock, mix.lock, Pipfile.lock, bun.lockb, uv.lock) changes via pull/merge/rebase/checkout, offering to run the ecosystem's install command.

gitsight.branchDivergence.enabled.description: Show a one-click notification when the branch you just checked out is behind its tracked upstream, naming the top contributors on the diverged side, with Rebase / Merge / Show diff actions.

gitsight.forgottenFiles.enabled.description: While a commit is being composed, show a status-bar pill if any file you edited in the last N days has worktree changes but isn't staged (the classic 'I forgot the test fixture' miss).

gitsight.forgottenFiles.days.description: How far back (in days) to consider a file 'recently edited' for the Forgotten Files diagnostic.

gitsight.forgottenFiles.includeClean.description: Also flag recently-edited files that are currently clean (no worktree changes). Off by default to keep the signal high.

gitsight.prePushLint.enabled.description: Before pushing, scan the to-push range (<upstream>..HEAD) for WIP/fixup commits and unresolved conflict markers, and offer a confirm/cancel/inspect prompt.

gitsight.prePushLint.scanPatches.description: Fetch each commit's patch body and scan for unresolved conflict markers. Disable to skip the per-commit `git show` round-trip on huge ranges.

gitsight.prePushLint.maxCommits.description: If the to-push range exceeds this many commits, skip the pre-push lint entirely (you've explicitly opted into a fast push).

gitsight.prePushLint.requireSubjectMatch.description: Optional JavaScript regex (e.g. '^(GH-|ABC-)\\d+') that every commit subject in the to-push range must match. Mismatches are warnings, not errors. Empty disables the check.

gitsight.filesIOwn.days.description: Shortlog scan window (days) for the 'Files I own' picker. Files where you are the dominant author within this window are included even without a CODEOWNERS rule.

gitsight.filesIOwn.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of owned files to surface in the 'Files I own' picker.

gitsight.filesIOwn.handles.description: Extra GitHub-style handles (e.g. '@sanjays2402') to treat as 'me' when matching CODEOWNERS rules, in addition to the one auto-derived from the noreply email.

gitsight.filesIOwn.emails.description: Extra email addresses to treat as 'me' when matching CODEOWNERS rules and the shortlog, in addition to git config user.email.

gitsight.autoStash.enabled.description: When a branch checkout is rejected because tracked files would be overwritten, offer to stash with a smart name, retry the switch, then re-apply.

gitsight.autoStash.autoApply.description: After an auto-stash + checkout, how to handle the stash: 'always' pop, 'never' keep, 'prompt' ask.

gitsight.worktreeDu.skip.description: Top-level directory / file names to skip when measuring a worktree. node_modules is counted by default because it's usually the surprise users are chasing.

gitsight.worktreeDu.maxEntries.description: Hard cap on filesystem entries to walk for the worktree disk-usage report. The report flags 'truncated' when this cap is hit.

gitsight.worktreeDu.topLevelLimit.description: How many top-level entries to show in the worktree disk-usage table.

gitsight.worktreeDu.largestLimit.description: How many of the largest individual files to list in the worktree disk-usage report.

gitsight.worktreeDu.followSymlinks.description: Follow symlinks when measuring a worktree. Off by default (matches `du -P`); turning it on can produce infinite-loop walks if the worktree contains circular symlinks.

gitsight.preCommitBridge.enabled.description: When ON, gitsight.preCommitBridge runs `.git/hooks/pre-commit` and presents a friendly picker for any failures (open file at line, copy --no-verify, disable hook). When OFF the command no-ops.

gitsight.fixtureLens.enabled.description: When ON, fixture/snapshot/golden files (under __snapshots__/, fixtures/, testdata/, cassettes/, or with .snap/.golden/.expected extensions) get a CodeLens at line 1 naming the last few authors so you know who to ping when output looks wrong.

gitsight.fixtureLens.maxCommits.description: How many recent commits to scan for fixture-author summarisation. Higher = more accurate author list, slower lens.

gitsight.fixtureLens.topAuthors.description: How many distinct authors to name inline in the fixture CodeLens before collapsing the rest into '+N more'.

gitsight.commitSearch.defaultMaxCount.description: Default cap on results for gitsight.searchCommitsAdvanced. Users can override per-query with `max:N` in the query text (hard cap 5000).

gitsight.branchPruner.defaultBase.description: Default base branch to compare against when pruning. Falls back to `master`, `trunk`, `develop`, or a picker if this branch doesn't exist.

gitsight.branchPruner.minAgeDays.description: Minimum age (days since last commit) for a branch to be eligible for pruning. Branches younger than this are listed but never pre-ticked.

gitsight.branchPruner.includeUnmerged.description: When ON, branches that are NOT merged into the base but are past the age threshold are also pre-ticked (deletes use `git branch -D` — destructive). When OFF (default) only fully-merged stale branches get deleted with `git branch -d`.

gitsight.branchPruner.protectedBranches.description: Extra local branch names you never want the pruner to suggest deleting. (`main`, `master`, `trunk`, `develop`, `dev`, `release`, `production`, `staging` are always protected.)

gitsight.sshKeyCheck.enabled.description: When ON, GitSight watches push/fetch/pull failures for known auth signatures (publickey, host-key, repo-not-found, dropped SSH, HTTPS credential prompt) and surfaces a one-click recovery picker. Turn OFF to get the raw git error back.

gitsight.sshKeyCheck.autoCheckOnActivate.description: When ON, run `git ls-remote --heads origin` ~3s after activation and surface the recovery picker if auth fails. Catches stale keys before you try to push.

gitsight.codespaces.machine.description: Pinned machine SKU for `gitsight.openInCodespaces` (e.g. `basicLinux32gb`, `standardLinux32gb`, `premiumLinux`). Leave empty to use your account default. Pinning any of machine/location/devcontainerPath switches the URL to GitHub's advanced-create form so the overrides are honoured.

gitsight.codespaces.location.description: Pinned region for `gitsight.openInCodespaces` (e.g. `UsEast`, `UsWest`, `EuropeWest`, `SoutheastAsia`). Leave empty for auto.

gitsight.codespaces.devcontainerPath.description: Pinned devcontainer.json path (relative to repo root) for `gitsight.openInCodespaces`. Leave empty to auto-detect; when 2+ devcontainers are found the picker will ask.

gitsight.submodules.enabled.description: When ON, show a status-bar pill summarising submodule state (in sync / out of sync / not init / conflict).

gitsight.submodules.hideWhenNone.description: When ON (default), the submodule pill is hidden if the repo has zero submodules. Turn OFF to keep a placeholder pill visible.

gitsight.submodules.recursive.description: When ON, run `git submodule status --recursive` so nested submodules are surfaced too.

gitsight.commitTestRunner.command.description: Default test command for `gitsight.commitTestRunner`. Run through the system shell so chained commands work (e.g. `npm install && npm test`).

gitsight.commitTestRunner.timeoutMs.description: Per-commit timeout in milliseconds for `gitsight.commitTestRunner` (default 5 min). Hitting the timeout records that commit as `error` and moves on.

gitsight.commitTestRunner.stopOnFirstFai.description: When ON, the runner stops at the first failing commit (faster for known-good → known-bad ranges). Off by default so you get the full picture.

gitsight.commitTestRunner.maxCommits.description: Cap on the number of commits the runner will iterate without an explicit confirmation. Going above this triggers a modal warning.

gitsight.defaultReviewers.fallbackBase.description: Base ref to diff against when no open PR is found for the current branch. Used to compute the changed-files set for `gitsight.defaultReviewersPicker`.

gitsight.defaultReviewers.includeTeams.description: When ON, team handles from CODEOWNERS (e.g. `@myorg/core`) are offered alongside individual users. Turn OFF if you only want to assign individual reviewers.

gitsight.defaultReviewers.exclude.description: GitHub handles to permanently exclude from `gitsight.defaultReviewersPicker` suggestions (e.g. bots, paused teammates). Accepts `@handle` or `@org/team`.

gitsight.defaultReviewers.roundRobin.description: When ON, the reviewer picker re-ranks suggestions within each coverage tier so the LEAST-recently-requested handles float to the top. Helps balance review load across owners with equal CODEOWNERS coverage. Requires the `gh` CLI.

gitsight.defaultReviewers.roundRobinWind.description: Number of recent PRs (any state) used to compute reviewer-request load for round-robin re-ranking. Each PR counts each handle at most once.

gitsight.defaultReviewers.shortlogFallba.description: F91: when a repo has no CODEOWNERS file, fall back to suggesting the top committers on the changed files (last 180 days). The same round-robin re-rank applies. Disable to require CODEOWNERS for reviewer suggestions.

F91: history window (in days) for the shortlog fallback. Larger windows surface long-tail contributors; smaller windows favour active maintainers. Capped at 7d minimum to filter out trivial fresh repos.

gitsight.defaultReviewers.shortlogPerTie.description: F91: maximum committers per coverage tier in the shortlog fallback. Default 5 keeps the picker focused; raise to 10+ for very large teams where the round-robin needs more rotation room.

gitsight.commitScaffold.enabled.description: When ON, prefill the SCM input box with a conventional-commit header (e.g. `feat(git): `) derived from the staged paths. Skipped when the input already has text or the staging is too noisy to classify confidently.

gitsight.commitScaffold.maxPaths.description: Maximum number of staged paths the scaffold will consider. Stagings larger than this are treated as too multi-concern to autoclassify.

gitsight.commitScaffold.minConfidence.description: Minimum confidence (0–1) required from the type classifier before a scaffold is written. The default `feat` fallback sits at 0.4 and is gated out.

gitsight.commitScaffold.scaffoldWithoutS.description: When ON, scaffold even when no scope can be derived (e.g. write `feat: ` instead of skipping). Off by default because scope-less scaffolds are usually noise.

gitsight.rerereCache.staleAfterDays.description: Resolved rerere entries older than this many days are flagged as stale in the visualizer. Stale resolutions can silently auto-apply old code; review them periodically.

gitsight.rerereCache.maxEntries.description: Maximum number of rerere cache entries the visualizer will list per invocation. Huge caches are truncated to keep the picker responsive.

gitsight.worktreePruner.minAgeDays.description: Minimum age (in days, by index mtime) before a worktree is considered for `gitsight.worktreePruner` removal. Missing-on-disk entries bypass this guard.

gitsight.worktreePruner.includeStaleOnly.description: When ON, surface stale-but-alive worktrees (have upstream + exist on disk + older than minAgeDays) as pruneSafe. Off by default — only missing-on-disk and upstream-gone entries are pruned automatically.

gitsight.worktreePruner.forceDirty.description: When ON, dirty worktrees in the prune selection get `--force` without an extra confirm modal. Use with care — it discards uncommitted changes.

gitsight.cherryPickScout.enabled.description: When ON, `gitsight.cherryPick` scans recent commits on the current branch for a same-subject-shape commit and surfaces a modal warning before re-applying. Turn OFF to skip the scout entirely.

gitsight.cherryPickScout.scanCommits.description: Maximum number of commits to scan on the current branch when looking for a prior cherry-pick. Larger numbers cover deeper release-branch history at the cost of one slow log call.

gitsight.cherryPickScout.scanSince.description: `git log --since` value for the scout scan (e.g. `30.days`, `1.year`). Limits how far back we look for an existing pick of the same subject.

gitsight.stashTrash.staleAfterDays.description: Stashes older than this many days are flagged as stale in the Trash Bin. Stale stashes whose source branch is also gone are pre-ticked for deletion.

gitsight.stashTrash.ancientAfterDays.description: Stashes older than this many days are considered ancient and pre-ticked for deletion regardless of whether the source branch still exists.

gitsight.stashTrash.extraLiveBranches.description: Extra branch names treated as still-alive when classifying stashes (use this when a stash's source branch only exists on a remote).

gitsight.reflogExplorer.windowSize.description: Number of reflog entries to load into the explorer picker. Larger windows surface deeper history at the cost of one slower reflog call.

gitsight.reflogExplorer.defaultFilter.description: Kinds to pre-tick in the filter chip. Empty array = show everything. Useful when you mostly use the explorer for undo (set to ["reset", "rebase", "merge"]).

gitsight.prePushMessageGate.enabled.description: When ON, `gitsight.push` runs the commit-message linter against every commit in the to-push range and blocks (or warns) when issues are found. Composes with the F14 pre-push lint.

gitsight.prePushMessageGate.blockAt.description: Severity floor that blocks the push. `error` blocks on lint errors only (subject too long, WIP prefix, missing issue ref). `warning` is strict and blocks on warnings too. `never` surfaces a warning but always lets the push through.

gitsight.prePushMessageGate.options.description: Lint options passed verbatim to the commit-message linter (same shape as the SCM input-box validator). Tune `maxSubjectLength`, `maxBodyLength`, etc.

gitsight.submoduleAutoPull.enabled.description: When ON, a passive watcher detects submodule gitlink moves between ref changes (pull / merge / rebase / checkout) and surfaces a toast with one-click `git submodule update` actions. Mirrors the F28 lockfile watcher shape.

gitsight.submoduleAutoPull.cooldownMinut.description: Don't re-surface the same submodule change toast within this many minutes. Prevents a multi-step rebase from spamming notifications.

gitsight.actionsPill.enabled.description: When ON, surface the latest GitHub Actions run for the current branch as a status-bar pill (requires `gh` CLI + a github.com remote + at least one workflow file in `.github/workflows/`).

gitsight.actionsPill.refreshSeconds.description: How often to poll `gh run list` for the latest run. Lower values catch state changes sooner at the cost of more API calls.

gitsight.actionsPill.hideOnSuccess.description: When ON, hide the pill entirely after a successful run. Quieter status bar; you only see the pill when something needs your attention.

gitsight.secretAudit.enabled.description: When ON, surface a status-bar pill warning when any `${{ secrets.X }}` reference in `.github/workflows/*` doesn't have a matching secret on GitHub (requires `gh` CLI auth). Pairs with `gitsight.actionsPill` — both are GitHub-only.

gitsight.secretAudit.refreshMinutes.description: How often to re-run `gh secret list` + rescan workflows for secret references. Lower values catch out-of-band secret changes sooner; higher values use less API budget.

gitsight.secretAudit.hideOnHealthy.description: When ON, hide the pill entirely when all referenced secrets are set. When OFF, the pill stays visible as a small `$(shield) N secrets ok` indicator.

gitsight.secretAudit.includeOrgSecrets.description: When ON, also count org-level secrets shared with this repo (via `gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/actions/secrets`). Disable if you've seen API rate-limit issues or if you want repo-scoped auditing only.

gitsight.diffSize.enabled.description: When ON, watches the staged diff size while you compose a commit; surfaces a status-bar pill + diagnostic suggesting a split when the diff crosses configurable line/file thresholds. Pairs with F60 commitScaffold + F84 regenerate so the suggestion shows up at commit-compose time, not push time.

gitsight.diffSize.lineThreshold.description: Total +/- line count above which the diff-size heuristic warns. 400 lines is the reviewer-fatigue threshold most teams converge on.

gitsight.diffSize.fileThreshold.description: File-count above which the diff-size heuristic warns. Independent of line count — 25 files at 5 lines each still benefits from a split.

gitsight.diffSize.hugeLineThreshold.description: Line count above which the diff-size heuristic escalates from `warning` to `huge` (red pill). Even style/chore commits get flagged at this size — strongly suggest splitting.

gitsight.diffSize.noisyDominance.description: Fraction (0..1) of lockfile / generated / vendored lines in the staged diff above which the warning shifts from `large diff` to `noisy diff` (lockfile dominant). Default 0.7 = 70%.

gitsight.diffSize.requireSCMInput.description: When ON, the diff-size pill only appears while the SCM input box has text (i.e. you're composing a commit). When OFF, the pill stays visible whenever staging is dirty.

gitsight.openAtLastTouched.scanCommits.description: How many recent commits to scan when mining the most recent touch of a file. Higher values find historic touches deeper in history at the cost of one slower `git log` call.

gitsight.forcePushGuard.enabled.description: When ON, the F71 force-push commands probe GitHub branch protection via `gh api` and refuse when the branch is protected and force-push is disallowed. Composes with the F14 pre-push lint and F69 commit-message gate. No-op for non-GitHub remotes.

gitsight.releasesCompanion.listLimit.description: How many releases to load into the GitHub Releases picker. Larger limits surface deeper history at the cost of one slower `gh release list` call.

gitsight.prReviewInbox.scope.description: Which repos to include in the PR review inbox. `all` searches every repo accessible to your gh CLI; `current` restricts to the workspace's origin GitHub repository.

gitsight.prReviewInbox.listLimit.description: How many PRs to load into the review inbox picker.

gitsight.prReviewInbox.includeDrafts.description: When ON, draft PRs awaiting your review appear in the inbox. Draft PRs are sorted to the end of the list and labelled as such.

gitsight.prTemplate.enabled.description: When ON, `gitsight.generatePullRequestDescription` folds AI-generated content into your repo's `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` (or any of the canonical variants - directory form, repo-root form, docs/ form). The template's checklist boxes and instruction comments are preserved verbatim; the AI's prose fills the prose sections.

gitsight.issueInsert.listLimit.description: How many GitHub issues to load into the picker for `gitsight.insertIssueReference` and siblings.

gitsight.issueInsert.includeClosed.description: When ON, closed issues appear in the picker (sorted after open ones). Useful when you're writing a postmortem and referencing the bug that just got fixed.

gitsight.issueInsert.qualifiedPrompt.description: When ON, the inserter prompts each invocation whether to use the bare `#NN` form or the qualified `org/repo#NN` form. OFF defaults to bare references (correct for the common single-repo case).

gitsight.whatsMine.listLimit.description: How many PRs / issues to pull per surface in `gitsight.whatsMine`. Loading three feeds at this cap means the picker shows up to 3 * limit GH rows plus the local commit window.

gitsight.whatsMine.commitWindowDays.description: How many days back to include in the "Your recent commits" section. 7 catches the typical week; bump to 30 for the monthly retrospective view.

gitsight.codeownersValidator.enabled.description: When ON, GitSight lints CODEOWNERS files (root, .github/, docs/) on every open / save / edit and emits findings into the Problems panel: invalid owners (errors), negation patterns + duplicate rules + shadowed rules (warnings), and empty-owner / dead-pattern rules (info).

gitsight.prCheckoutPreflight.recentWindo.description: How many days back to consider when computing the conflict-risk overlap between PR files and the user's recent commits. 7 catches the typical week of in-flight work.

gitsight.prTemplateLint.enabled.description: When ON, GitSight passively lints markdown PR description scratch buffers (the `(gitsight) Pull Request Description` flow) plus any `PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` you open, surfacing placeholder leftovers (TODO/TBD/FIXME), instruction comments, empty sections, and untouched-from-template sections in the Problems panel.

gitsight.prTemplateLint.flagEmptyCheckbo.description: When ON, every unchecked `- [ ]` row in the PR body produces an info-level finding. OFF is the gentler default — unchecked boxes are often intentional placeholders that the reviewer ticks during merge.

gitsight.prTemplateLint.requiredSections.description: Section headings that MUST be present in every PR body (matched case-insensitively). A missing required section emits an info-level finding. Leave empty to disable the check.

gitsight.inactiveReviewers.staleAfterDay.description: How many days a requested reviewer can be silent before they're flagged as inactive. 3 is the typical "end of the work week" threshold; tune higher for slow-rolling teams or lower for shipping daily.

gitsight.inactiveReviewers.includeTeams.description: When ON, team handles (org/team-slug) are eligible for nudging. GitHub expands a team @-mention to every member server-side, which is usually what you want; set OFF to nudge only individual reviewers.

gitsight.inactiveReviewers.includeCommen.description: When ON, reviewers who left only a COMMENTED review (no approval, no changes-requested) are still considered inactive and eligible for a nudge. Default OFF treats commented-and-walked-away as "engaged enough" to skip the nudge.

gitsight.prTimelinePill.enabled.description: When ON, GitSight shows a status-bar pill summarising the current branch's open PR (ready / waiting on N / +N since review / conflicts / changes requested / draft). Click for an action menu. Hides silently when there's no open PR or no github.com origin.

gitsight.prTimelinePill.refreshSeconds.description: How often (seconds) the PR timeline pill polls gh for fresh state. 60 is the default; bump higher on networks where gh round-trips are slow, lower for tight feedback loops.

gitsight.prTimelinePill.hideWhenReady.description: When ON, the pill hides when the PR is approved + mergeable (ready state). Reduces status-bar noise once the PR is just waiting on you to click merge.

gitsight.prDraftSync.enabled.description: When ON, a successful `gitsight.push` checks whether the current branch has an open DRAFT PR on GitHub and refreshes its body from `<base>..HEAD` (commits + files list) inside a managed marker block. Non-draft PRs are skipped, and anything outside the markers is preserved verbatim.

gitsight.prDraftSync.maxCommits.description: Cap on the commit list embedded in the synced PR body. Commits are listed oldest-first; older commits are truncated when the count exceeds the cap.

gitsight.prDraftSync.maxFiles.description: Cap on the file list embedded in the synced PR body. Files are listed alphabetically; the list is truncated when it exceeds the cap.

gitsight.prDraftSync.baseRef.description: Override the base ref used for the commit/file diff. Empty (default) uses the PR's own baseRefName as reported by `gh pr view`. Useful when your repo's default branch differs from the PR's base for some reason.

gitsight.stagedConflictGate.enabled.description: When ON, a passive scanner watches `git diff --cached` for unresolved conflict markers in STAGED hunks and surfaces them as a status-bar pill + Problems-panel diagnostics. Sits between the F34 editor-buffer linter and the F14 pre-push gate.

gitsight.stagedConflictGate.severity.description: Diagnostic severity for staged conflict markers. Default `error` makes them gutter-red and unmissable; `warning` lets them coexist with other warnings; `info` is the least intrusive.

gitsight.stashOnSwitch.enabled.description: When ON, after a successful branch checkout GitSight scans the stash list for stashes previously made WHILE ON the destination branch and offers to re-apply them via a toast (`Apply newest` / `Pick from list` / `Dismiss`). Bookends F31 + F43 + F48 into a complete stash UX.

gitsight.stashOnSwitch.freshDays.description: Stashes newer than this many days are tagged `fresh` in the picker. Tiering matches F25 branchAge.

gitsight.stashOnSwitch.agingDays.description: Stashes newer than this many days are tagged `aging`; older ones are `old`. Must be ≥ `freshDays`.

gitsight.recentContributors.enabled.description: When ON, every tracked file in the explorer gets a small badge showing the number of unique contributors who touched it in the recent commit window, with a rich tooltip listing them. Click `Show Recent Contributors…` in the command palette to open the picker for the active file.

gitsight.recentContributors.scanCommits.description: How many recent commits per file to scan for the contributor list. Higher values surface more history at the cost of a slightly slower `git log` call per file (cached per file-mtime).

gitsight.recentContributors.maxInTooltip.description: Cap on how many contributors appear in the file decoration tooltip. The picker always shows the full list.

gitsight.graphExport.directory.description: Workspace-relative directory to write exported commit-graph SVGs into. Empty (default) writes to the workspace root. Created if missing. Filenames are timestamped (`gitsight-graph-YYYY-MM-DD-HHmm.svg`).
